hooks.name: Block agent writes to .env and API keys in files
hooks.description: The user edits .env by hand. Blocks the agent from writing to a real .env file or writing anything that looks like an API key. .env.example is allowed.

hooks.name: Block agent reads of .env
hooks.description: Keeps API keys out of the agent's context. The agent can read .env.example and app/config.py instead.

hooks.name: Block shell access to .env
hooks.description: Stops workarounds like cat .env, echo KEY=... >> .env, sed -i on .env, or source .env.
